Results.ReviewText: The grill works fine.  But the “one-touch cleaning” is nothing special and should not be promoted as a particular reason to buy this product.  It’s not really “one-touch”, and cleaning the grill of ash residue is really no different from brands and models that don’t promote such a feature.
Results.Title: One touch cleaning nothing special

Results.ReviewText: Packaging was good. The price was great. Assembly was easy and straightforward. Plenty of room to smoke two 7.5 lbs pork butts. Temperature control was simple and responsive. Overall a quality and solid grill for the price.

Results.ReviewText: You can't really argue with this grill. For one thing, it's an inanimate object, so arguing with it would be pointless. If you're someone who grills frequently (and I grill year-round, even in the winter), you can only reasonably expect to get so much mileage out of one of these.

Results.ReviewText: This is a good grill. The base model needs to be enhanced with the Weber 7478 Charcoal Grill Tool Hook Handle. In my opinion that would have made my experience better out of the box. Also the hook for the grill cover lid is way too small. Even with remembering which side the hook is on (by using the Weber logo and grill cover handle placement) it’s not very easy to hook without a bracket hinder. If it was maybe two inches longer it would be easier to use. Personally, I would like the legs to be just a bit taller. I’m 6’1” so I would have appreciate a little more height. With a little enhancements this grill will be awesome.
Results.Title: Almost Great - Enhance the Base Model

Results.ReviewText: The kettle grill is working great. I use it for offset smoking/indirect cooking. Results.ReviewText:
This is my 4-5th Weber and my 3rd or 4th Kettle in 45 years so I’m a little biased. 

Every Thanksgiving I smoke a Turkey which always comes out great. 

The current model goes together very quickly and easily, is well constructed and the ash removal process is very nice. It actually seems more robust than my last one from 15 years ago. Handle guard on lid is an improvement since then and the bottom storage rack is more solid. 

Since my most common cooking method on the Kettle is indirect heat, I have the grate with wings that allows for the addition of more coals. A must have.
Results.Title: Looooong time Weber owner

741001.Description: Stay true to the modern version of the kettle that started it all—the Original Kettle®, invented by Weber’s founder, and loved around the world. Its ultra-durable, porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, while the dampers easily adjust for precise temperature control. With a One-Touch™ cleaning system for easy cleanup after a long day of grilling, the Original Kettle® will always be the grill built for everyone.•	 Holds up to 13 burgers made with a Weber burger press•	 One-Touch™ cleaning system provides hassle-free ash cleanup•	 Porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, and won’t rust or peel•	 Use the lid hook to avoid placing the lid on the ground while grilling•	 Dampers allow you to easily control the temperature inside your grill•	 Durable plated steel cooking grate retains heat and is easy to clean
